answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The pigment cap is applied at intake and onyx makes public the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a umber tag. That is 21 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
